# www.urology-textbook.com:
# Free and Up-To-Date

These pages offer free, up-to-date information on all major areas of urology. While the English
translation from the original German version is still in progress, detailed descriptions of the most
important urological diseases are already available. The goal: clear, structured knowledge for
clinical practice and medical education.

This website is designed for physicians and medical professionals. It presents diseases of the
genital organs through detailed text and images. Some content may not be suitable for children or
sensitive readers. Many illustrations are available exclusively to Steady members. Are you a
physician and interested in supporting this project? [Join Steady to unlock full access][21] to all
images and enjoy an ad-free experience. Try it free for 7 days—no obligation.

**New release:** The first edition of the Urology Textbook as an e-book—ideal for offline reading
and quick reference. With over 1300 pages and hundreds of illustrations, it’s the perfect companion
for residents and medical students. After your 7-day trial has ended, you will receive a download
link for your exclusive e-book.

The [index][22] provides an alphabetical list of diseases, procedures, and relevant keywords. All
chapters are free and accessible. Many new sections and images will be published shortly; please
refer to my Steady page [https://steady.page/de/urology/posts][23] for more information.

## About the Author

[Dirk Manski, Author of Urology-Textbook.com]

Dr. Dirk Manski studied medicine at the Free University of Berlin. He received his doctorate in 2002
at the University of Erlangen with a thesis on collagen VI signal transduction in mesenchymal cells,
supervised by Prof. Dr. Dr. Schuppan. He completed his urology residency at the Charité Berlin and
Klinikum Kempten in Bavaria.

From 2006 to 2014, Dr. Manski served as an attending urologist at the University Hospital Augsburg.
Since 2015, he has been working as a [urologist in private practice][24] and as an attending
physician at the Stadtklinik Diako in Augsburg.

His clinical focus includes endourology, urooncology, laparoscopy and reconstructive surgery.

Dr. Manski is the author and editor of www.urology-textbook.com, which he has been developing and
managing since 2014 to provide high-quality, evidence-based urological education. [PDF
Abstract][25].

## What is Urology?

Urology is a surgical and medical specialty that deals with the basics, diagnosis, and treatment of
urinary tract and sexual organs diseases. The urologist thus treats diseases of the [kidneys][26],
[ureters][27], [bladder][28], [urethra][29], [testes][30], [prostate][31], [penis][32], and [adrenal
glands][33]. Each organ can be affected by congenital diseases, infections, trauma, benign diseases,
or malignant tumors.

# www.urology-textbook.com:
# Free and Up-To-Date

These pages offer free, up-to-date information on all major areas of urology. While the English
translation from the original German version is still in progress, detailed descriptions of the most
important urological diseases are already available. The goal: clear, structured knowledge for
clinical practice and medical education.

This website is designed for physicians and medical professionals. It presents diseases of the
genital organs through detailed text and images. Some content may not be suitable for children or
sensitive readers. Many illustrations are available exclusively to Steady members. Are you a
physician and interested in supporting this project? [Join Steady to unlock full access][21] to all
images and enjoy an ad-free experience. Try it free for 7 days—no obligation.

**New release:** The first edition of the Urology Textbook as an e-book—ideal for offline reading
and quick reference. With over 1300 pages and hundreds of illustrations, it’s the perfect companion
for residents and medical students. After your 7-day trial has ended, you will receive a download
link for your exclusive e-book.

The [index][22] provides an alphabetical list of diseases, procedures, and relevant keywords. All
chapters are free and accessible. Many new sections and images will be published shortly; please
refer to my Steady page [https://steady.page/de/urology/posts][23] for more information.

## About the Author

[Dirk Manski, Author of Urology-Textbook.com]

Dr. Dirk Manski studied medicine at the Free University of Berlin. He received his doctorate in 2002
at the University of Erlangen with a thesis on collagen VI signal transduction in mesenchymal cells,
supervised by Prof. Dr. Dr. Schuppan. He completed his urology residency at the Charité Berlin and
Klinikum Kempten in Bavaria.

From 2006 to 2014, Dr. Manski served as an attending urologist at the University Hospital Augsburg.
Since 2015, he has been working as a [urologist in private practice][24] and as an attending
physician at the Stadtklinik Diako in Augsburg.

His clinical focus includes endourology, urooncology, laparoscopy and reconstructive surgery.

Dr. Manski is the author and editor of www.urology-textbook.com, which he has been developing and
managing since 2014 to provide high-quality, evidence-based urological education. [PDF
Abstract][25].

## What is Urology?

Urology is a surgical and medical specialty that deals with the basics, diagnosis, and treatment of
urinary tract and sexual organs diseases. The urologist thus treats diseases of the [kidneys][26],
[ureters][27], [bladder][28], [urethra][29], [testes][30], [prostate][31], [penis][32], and [adrenal
glands][33]. Each organ can be affected by congenital diseases, infections, trauma, benign diseases,
or malignant tumors.

## News

### Verathon Expands Airway Portfolio with SamplePro™ for BFlex™ 2, Delivering a Spill-Proof
### Specimen Collection System

Verathon^{®}, a global medical device company known for its GlideScope^{®} and BFlex™ brands, today
announced the U.S. launch of SamplePro™, an integrated closed-system specimen collection solution
purpose-built for the BFlex™ 2 single-use bronchoscopy platform. SamplePro extends Verathon's
leading airway portfolio with a self-sealing sampling solution that protects the collected specimen
while safeguarding clinicians and patients.

[ Read More ][155]
[View All News][156]
[verathon-expands-into-urology-with-cflex-article-hero]

### Verathon Expands Urology Portfolio with CFlex™, Its First Single-Use Flexible Cystoscope

Verathon^{®}, a global medical device company known for its GlideScope^{®}, BFlex^{®}, and
BladderScan^{®} brands, today announced the U.S. launch of CFlex™, an FDA 510(k)-cleared single-use
flexible cystoscope. CFlex extends Verathon's urology portfolio into cystoscopy, applying the
company's single-use endoscopy experience to a design built for cystoscopy workflow.

[ Read More ][157]
[View All News][158]

### Verathon Launches GlideScope ClearFit Video Laryngoscope Offering Cost-Effective Airway
### Management

Verathon^{®}, a global leader in airway management solutions, announces the launch of GlideScope^{®}
ClearFit^{™}, a cover-based video laryngoscope designed to deliver airway management capabilities
with cost efficiency. ClearFit combines one reusable video baton with an industry-leading selection
of six single-use covers, including Mac, Miller, and Hyperangle style options, to address a wide
range of patient types and clinical settings.

[ Read More ][159]
[View All News][160]

Trial published in the Journal of American Medical Association concluded that GlideScope^{®}
hyperangulated video laryngoscopy outperformed direct laryngoscopy for endotracheal intubation in
the operating room.

### Verathon Expands Airway Portfolio with SamplePro™ for BFlex™ 2, Delivering a Spill-Proof
### Specimen Collection System

Verathon^{®}, a global medical device company known for its GlideScope^{®} and BFlex™ brands, today
announced the U.S. launch of SamplePro™, an integrated closed-system specimen collection solution
purpose-built for the BFlex™ 2 single-use bronchoscopy platform. SamplePro extends Verathon's
leading airway portfolio with a self-sealing sampling solution that protects the collected specimen
while safeguarding clinicians and patients.

[ Read More ][155]
[View All News][156]
[verathon-expands-into-urology-with-cflex-article-hero]

### Verathon Expands Urology Portfolio with CFlex™, Its First Single-Use Flexible Cystoscope

Verathon^{®}, a global medical device company known for its GlideScope^{®}, BFlex^{®}, and
BladderScan^{®} brands, today announced the U.S. launch of CFlex™, an FDA 510(k)-cleared single-use
flexible cystoscope. CFlex extends Verathon's urology portfolio into cystoscopy, applying the
company's single-use endoscopy experience to a design built for cystoscopy workflow.

[ Read More ][157]
[View All News][158]

### Verathon Launches GlideScope ClearFit Video Laryngoscope Offering Cost-Effective Airway
### Management

Verathon^{®}, a global leader in airway management solutions, announces the launch of GlideScope^{®}
ClearFit^{™}, a cover-based video laryngoscope designed to deliver airway management capabilities
with cost efficiency. ClearFit combines one reusable video baton with an industry-leading selection
of six single-use covers, including Mac, Miller, and Hyperangle style options, to address a wide
range of patient types and clinical settings.

## How Vistaar Works

Combining AI automation with global expert analysis.

[Technology]

#### Technology

Vistaar automates heavy manual processes of collecting, reviewing and comparing (including
translation) using Automation & Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help you manage regulatory change
and compliance proactively.

End-to-end Digital process automates and simplifies data acquisition, transformation, reporting and
sharing.

[Plus]
[Global Resources]

#### Global Resources

Our global team of Analysts and Subject Experts, with expertise across a diverse range of
industries, geographies and policy areas, collaborate with functional specialists to analyze
regulations including purpose, applicability, requirements highlights and more.

[Equal]
[Value To You]

#### Value To You
* Improve Regulatory Foresight
* Cut down Alert volume & noise
* Unifying system covering full cycle of Regulatory requirements process
* Data & Workflow Automations to reduce manual work
* Get Compliant

## Powerful Solutions for Compliance

Everything you need to stay compliant across global markets.

[summarize]

#### SUMMARIZE

Comprehensive regulatory requirements database with AI-powered summaries covering clinical,
technical, QMS, and market launch requirements across all major markets.

[hunt]

#### HUNT

AI-driven contextual search across 2M+ regulations and guidance documents. Smart alerts, watchlists,
and full workflow management with project tracking.

[clin-intel]

#### CLIN INTEL

Global clinical trials repository with insights spanning 750K+ trials. Understand trial design
trends and make data-driven development decisions.

[label-intel]

#### LABEL INTEL

Database of 300K+ approved labels for drugs and devices from USA, EU, Canada, and UK. Subscribe to
alerts for new labels matching your criteria.

[imapct-assessment]

#### Impact Assessment

AI-driven regulatory impact assessment helps you understand how changes affect your products. Create
traceable matrices of laws, regulations, and guidance.

[smart-alerts]

#### Smart Alerts

Configurable alerts that target only regulatory changes affecting you. Reduce noise and focus on
what matters most to your organization.

# "BE YOURSELF WITH EACH BREATH"

*Zielinski & Rozen is a niche perfume brand whose roots date back to 1905. The brand’s history at
the same time is the history of the family because its name comes from two surnames that matter
deeply to its founder and the only perfumer Erez Rozen. Zielinski is his mother’s maiden name. Rozen
is his father’s.Today the product range consists of perfumes, body, hand and hair care products, and
home fragrances.*
